# Microsoft Blend / WPF Designer comparison and Xamora 0.4

15 September 2026

Xamora 0.4 adds an IDE docking workspace around the existing designer, motion timeline and appearance tools. It does **not** implement every Microsoft Blend or Visual Studio feature. This comparison separates implemented browser functionality from native framework and IDE integrations that remain necessary.

Microsoft describes Blend and the Visual Studio XAML Designer as sharing a design/IDE foundation, with Blend offering additional visual-state, animation, path, and template workflows. Those are the focus of this release. [Microsoft comparison](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/xaml-tools/designing-xaml-in-visual-studio?view=visualstudio).

## Native semantics that guided implementation

Storyboards target named objects and property paths. An animation supplies a temporary effective value; stopping it or using FillBehavior Stop releases that influence without overwriting the source property. Repeat, reverse, and nested clocks affect the sampled local time. The browser evaluator follows these rules for its supported subset. [WPF Storyboards](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/desktop/wpf/graphics-multimedia/storyboards-overview), [timing behaviors](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/desktop/wpf/graphics-multimedia/timing-behaviors-overview).

The ending keyframe determines how a segment interpolates. Uniform keys divide time; Paced keys divide it according to value distance. Cubic splines solve their x coordinate to obtain the y progress. Imported comments and explicit collection property elements remain part of the authored tree. [Keyframe animation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/desktop/wpf/graphics-multimedia/key-frame-animations-overview).

Each VisualStateGroup has one active state, while multiple groups can coexist. A WPF VisualState contains a Storyboard. An empty Normal state releases the preceding state's animations. Generated transitions interpolate between outgoing and incoming effective values; an explicit transition Storyboard can also contribute. [VisualStateManager](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.windows.visualstatemanager), [VisualTransition](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.windows.visualtransition).

Controllable native Storyboards are named on BeginStoryboard. PauseStoryboard, ResumeStoryboard, and StopStoryboard refer to that name through BeginStoryboardName. Browser prototype commands are an additional project format and are not automatically a Microsoft.Xaml.Behaviors implementation. [Storyboard overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/desktop/wpf/graphics-multimedia/storyboards-overview), [Microsoft XAML Behaviors](https://github.com/microsoft/XamlBehaviorsWpf/wiki).

Local values take precedence over style setters and style triggers; active animations can override local values. The implemented subset selects the closest applicable implicit style or an explicit style and follows BasedOn, rather than combining all ancestor styles. Main-dictionary resources outrank merged entries, and later merges outrank earlier merges. [Dependency-property precedence](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/desktop/wpf/properties/dependency-property-value-precedence), [merged dictionaries](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/desktop/wpf/systems/xaml-resources-merged-dictionaries).

RenderTransform changes rendering after layout. LayoutTransform participates in native measurement and arrangement; Xamora preserves it and reports its preview boundary. Design-time d: values apply only to design surfaces, not runtime preview or HTML export. [Transforms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/desktop/wpf/graphics-multimedia/transforms-overview), [design-time data](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/xaml-tools/xaml-designtime-data?view=visualstudio).

## Qualification and next engineering work

The automated suite checks the model, authored XAML, timing, state isolation, renderer mappings, prototype rollback, template-instance identities and deterministic runtime behavior. It does not establish pixel parity or native loadability. See [VALIDATION.md](VALIDATION.md) for the executed checks.

The largest remaining projects are a native WPF/Avalonia preview/metadata host, a semantic XAML language service connected to real projects, additional framework animation adapters, full vector/brush semantics, and browser/native/device qualification. Full Blend/WPF Designer parity is unfinished.

## Implementation update — 0.5

The editor now includes explicit Design/Code/Split/Views modes, solution files/folders and path-aware dictionary resolution, nested IDE menus, direct text/rotation/path handles, typed property and resource editors, retained multi-view cards, inline connection editing, multi-key timeline operations and supported canvas recording. These close concrete authoring gaps in the earlier implementation. They do not complete Blend/Visual Studio parity: semantic language services, native compilation/preview, native project/dependency handling, full framework metadata and advanced animation contracts remain adapter work. [Editor workflows](EDITOR-WORKFLOWS.md) describes exact behavior and [Validation](VALIDATION.md) records the executed checks.
